title: At the table with John Mack in England on the day he died

tellings.quote: England when he was there and I sat at the table with him and we talked about some stuff when he died that day

plain: A guest named Joe McMoneagle says he sat at a table in England with a man named John Mack and talked with him on the day Mack died, in 2004. McMoneagle tells this as something he was there for, and says only that they "talked about some stuff", without saying what.
